chooseConnectionStrategyDialog.title: Choose connection strategy
chooseConnectionStrategyDialog.description: Instana attempts to retrieve monitoring data via a WebSocket connection. In certain scenarios it can happen that a WebSocket connection cannot be established, e.g., with restrictive corporate proxies. The Instana user interface by default will attempt to leverage a fallback connection strategy to retrieve monitoring data after some retries. You can configure this strategy to improve your experience based on known network and setup realities.
